title: Complex character: face-priority control and whole-figure 16px interpretations
source: Owner-selected red-hood character reference in the supplied comparison board; original creator and license are not established here.
scope: Source-conditioned experimental character study, separate from Miniworld. No production integration or complete source likeness approved.

methods.faceControl: Retained earlier face-oriented 16px control. Its complete generation history is not counted by this board.
methods.centralMedian: One per-channel median from the central 50% of each detected chip; edge-connected empty gray cells removed, then the retained palette applied.
methods.regionAllocation: Each detected chip interior mapped to a fixed 32x32 block; the existing structure converter produces the 16x16 result with the retained palette.

review.historicalSourceIdentityReview: Whole-figure candidates did not retain the original expression or lantern construction sufficiently.
review.laterUserStyleReview: Both whole-figure variants retained as liked compact style references; no preference order specified.
review.interpretation: Whole-sprite proportion/style preference is distinct from complete source identity, general method validity and production acceptance.
